title: Caption-aware MoveClip
aggregateCanonical: sha256 of sorted "digest  path\n" lines of sourceSha256
bounds: MoveClip with captions is no longer CAPTION_SYNC_EDIT_NOT_IMPLEMENTED. The selected clip, and on a persistent-audio timeline its linked members, translate together. clipLocal cues and markers follow the host; absolute cues and default absolute markers stay at authored times; source-anchored cues reproject when the source window still covers them.

The vacated source is left as a gap; this is not auto-close as a MoveClips mode. A colliding destination is whole-group COLLISION. Uncovering a source window is still whole-group ANCHOR_OUT_OF_RANGE. Lifting a clipLocal-marker host is still REF_NOT_FOUND.

A real UI path imports AV, extracts persistent audio, adds a clipLocal cue, uses the new Move control for 15 frames, undoes and redoes that command, archives a fork, exports a VTT sidecar, and still refuses preview/MP4 burn-in. The same persist path is also exercised with MoveClip through the SDK.

MoveClips, including insert-move leave-gap and includeLinks=false, is unchanged. Leave-gap and ripple DeleteClip / TrimClip stay as already delivered. The table 0.02s AV offset is off the 30 fps grid and still refuses OFF_FRAME_GRID; alignment stays 1/30 s.

Already-delivered leave-gap trim/delete, single-range ripple delete/close, shorten and lengthen RippleTrimClip, video-only and linked-audio TrimClip(ripple:true), DeleteClip(ripple:true) and leave-gap DeleteClip, reject/overwrite/insert, includeLinks=false, insert-move leave-gap, caption default clipLocal / follow / interval / source-window, split and leave-gap rebind/remnants, marker absolute default / clipLocal follow / ripple interval, 1000 seeded random undo, and the opened section-3 geometry matrix stay unchanged. No silent caption or marker drop. No MP4 burn-in. No new persistence table. Auto-close is not a MoveClips mode.
Not auto-close-on-move, new-track, cross-project bake, OS clipboard, I-006 roll/slip/slide, source-interval crop, field-aware inverse, marker sidecar formats, or the full section-3 matrix.
I-005 and I-010 remain partial; 87 count and XD10 stay separately counted. Intermittent underrun, old-writer schema9 as a product qualification, and other-end GPU physical sync remain unproven.
